summary: Open source Notion alternative with docs, wikis, databases and AI that keeps you in control of your own data.
whatItDoes: AppFlowy is an AI collaborative workspace for notes, docs, team wikis, task databases and Kanban boards. It runs as a desktop app on macOS, Windows and Linux, as a mobile app, and can be self-hosted.
problem: Tools like Notion keep your data on someone else's servers. AppFlowy offers a similar workspace while letting you keep full control of your data.
whoFor: People looking for an open source Notion alternative
Teams that want a shared wiki and project databases
Organisations that want to self-host their workspace
Developers who want to build on a Flutter and Rust codebase
whyChoose: Its stated values are data privacy first, a reliable native experience and community-driven extensibility, with one codebase in Flutter and Rust across platforms.
requirements: A computer running macOS, Windows or Linux, or an iPhone, or an Android phone on Android 10 or above (ARMv7 is not supported)
overview: AppFlowy is an AI workspace for bringing projects, wikis and teams together. You write docs and notes, build databases for tasks and projects, plan work on Kanban boards, comment on database rows and ask AI questions about your team wiki.

It is built with Flutter and Rust and is available as a desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux, on the App Store for iPhone and on the Play Store for Android. You can also self-host it or build it from source.
The team says plainly that it doesn't claim to outperform Notion on features and design yet; its focus is data control, a native experience and a community others can build on.

steps.title: Download AppFlowy

steps.title: iPhone
steps.body: Install AppFlowy from the App Store.

steps.title: Android

steps.title: Build from source
